policy.scope: Canonical numeric Feature COUNTER sibling groups only.
policy.pairing: Consecutive pairable COUNTER controls pair left-to-right as 6+6. An odd final counter is not modified.
policy.manualTotals: Game-total/manual-game counters remain full width and break sibling groups even when legacy canonical mode says COUNTER.
policy.existingSix: Existing gridSpan=6 entries are not modified solely to change compactness.
policy.evidence: Evidence/setting-hint presentation sections are deferred to the separate Evidence redesign.
policy.contractDrift: Machines whose canonical input IDs are absent from the current machine package are reported and skipped, not silently migrated.
